issues.description: resolve(from, '..', s) misuses pathe.resolve and changes resolution semantics for absolute sources
issues.detail: The change swaps `resolve(s || '', from)` for `resolve(from, '..', s || '')`. `resolve` from pathe treats later absolute args as anchors, so absolute `s` still works, but for relative `s` the old code resolved relative to CWD with `from` as fallback, while the new code resolves relative to the directory of `from`. That's likely the intended fix, but it should have a unit test in packages/utils — none was added.

issues.description: Synchronous readFileSync inside stack-trace parsing can block and repeat I/O per error
issues.detail: `getSourceMap` is invoked for every frame of every error and does `existsSync` + `readFileSync` + `convertSourceMap.fromSource` synchronously without caching. For a failing test with many frames or many failing tests in node_modules, this re-reads and re-parses the same files repeatedly on the main thread. A per-run Map<file, SourceMap|undefined> cache scoped to the test run would prevent quadratic-ish behavior.

issues.description: Silent swallow of readFileSync/convertSourceMap errors not handled
issues.detail: `readFileSync` and `convertSourceMap.fromSource`/`fromMapFileSource` can throw on permission errors, malformed base64, or invalid JSON (e.g., a file with a // # sourceMappingURL= comment pointing to corrupt data). An uncaught throw inside `getSourceMap` will abort `parseErrorStacktrace`, replacing a user's real test error with a source-map parsing crash. Wrap in try/catch returning undefined.

issues.description: createConvertSourceMapReadMap returns '{}' which is not a valid source map
issues.detail: When the referenced .map file does not exist, the fallback returns the string `'{}'`. convert-source-map will treat this as a map with no mappings/sources, which is acceptable but may produce surprising 'no original location' results downstream rather than treating the file as having no source map at all. Consider returning a minimal valid v3 map (`{"version":3,"sources":[],"mappings":""}`) or letting the absence propagate.

issues.description: Importing SourceMap type from 'rollup' just for a return annotation adds a heavy type dep boundary
issues.detail: `import type { SourceMap } from 'rollup'` is used only as the return type of `extractSourcemapFromFile`. Since `convert-source-map`'s `toObject()` returns `RawSourceMap`-shaped data, and `@types/convert-source-map` is already added, prefer its type or a local shape to avoid coupling test-run.ts to rollup's type surface for a one-line annotation.

issues.description: moduleGraph.getModuleById uses raw file path, may miss URL-keyed entries
issues.detail: Vite's moduleGraph keys by id which is often a normalized URL/path; passing the raw `file` from a stack frame may miss a module that was transformed (returning `mod?.transformResult` undefined) and then incorrectly applying an external-module source-map path on a file Vite actually transformed. Consider using `getModulesByFile` or normalizing the path before lookup.

review.summary: The fix addresses external-module stack-trace source-mapping by reading and parsing source maps on demand and by tweaking source resolution in DecodedMap. The main concerns are runtime robustness (no try/catch around sync I/O and source-map parsing, no caching across many frames/errors) and a behavioral change in `resolve(from, '..', s)` that deserves a focused unit test. Minor issues: the empty-object fallback for missing .map files, importing SourceMap type from rollup, and using moduleGraph.getModuleById with a raw filesystem path.
